page.layout: Printed page 242 (running head DE VERO VSV). One main text block of justified lines. Left margin holds many marginal notes (references, Tertullian, Epiph., Chrysostomus, Gregorius, Augustinus, Lactantius, etc.). Right margin has no notes. Bottom right: a catchword-like word "tibiam".
